lexical.anchor: The independent line of research appears to have arrived at a Kernel concept without depending on the new probability-space hypothesis. It also independently identifies essentially the same core capacities: identity, evidence, provenance/history, context, contradiction, temporal evolution, constitutional admissibility, deterministic state transition. And it explicitly arrives at KnowledgeAggregate -> admissibility -> deterministic state transition as the minimum Kernel.
